notes.title: Visual Overhaul Update!
notes.content:
>Overhauled visuals
>Added Timer to Mazes
>Add local leader board to Game so you can track your times. Just type in a tag name after the maze is complete and click enter.
>Add mouse support to menus
>Made changes to some levels
>Changed Lv. 10
>Added different sized enemies to some levels

notes.title: Thank you so much! And what would you like to see?
notes.content:
JMJ

Hello,
I would like to thank everyone that has bought Jim's Adventure! I hope to up date this game and make it more enjoyable for you the players. I would like to ask you, what would you like to see added to the game?
